basics.name: Nikhil Singh
basics.label: Research Engineer, AtheroPoint LLC
basics.summary: Research Engineer at AtheroPoint LLC. I build transformer and Mamba models for carotid ultrasound segmentation, automated cIMT and plaque measurement, and cardiovascular risk assessment.

work.name: AtheroPoint LLC
work.summary: Principal Investigator: Prof. Jasjit S. Suri. Deep learning for carotid ultrasound analysis and cardiovascular disease risk stratification.
highlights: Built UNet-transformer and Mamba models for carotid ultrasound segmentation
Automated cIMT and plaque-burden measurement from segmented far-wall boundaries
Validated against expert tracings across 5K+ annotated scans
Deployed FastAPI/AWS inference services powering AtheroEdge 4.0

work.name: Green Rider Technologies LLP
work.summary: Multilingual instruction-tuning data curation and parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models.
highlights: Curated 200K+ EN/HI/ES records for instruction tuning
Automated benchmarking across MMLU, GSM8K, and prompt-injection probes

courses: Studied at Bharati Vidyapeeth's College of Engineering, New Delhi
Research assistant under Dr. Arun Kumar Dubey
